tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation, RFC 8949) as the wire serialisation format. It was chosen for its standardisation and for fewer version-compatibility problems than ad-hoc schemes.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md
